request: 只给一句不超过100字的中文视频提示词：8秒，两个成年刀客站在石桥两端静静对峙，各自微调右手握柄，不交手，固定全景，日间自然光，无台词。不要工程说明，不生成视频。

commands.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = 'D:\Temp\combat-extension-nws2d7rg\runs\M04'
$skill = 'D:\Temp\combat-extension-nws2d7rg\candidate\skills\combat-director\SKILL.md'
$request = Join-Path $root 'request.txt'
'=== SKILL.md ==='
Get-Content -LiteralPath $skill -Raw -Encoding UTF8
'=== REQUEST ==='
Get-Content -LiteralPath $request -Raw -Encoding UTF8
foreach ($path in @($skill, $request)) {
    $script:records.inputs += [ordered]@{ path = $path; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); read_mode = 'full'; method = 'Get-Content -Raw'; }
}
$script:records.request = Get-Content -LiteralPath $request -Raw -Encoding UTF8

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = 'D:\Temp\combat-extension-nws2d7rg\runs\M04'
$answer = '8秒，日间自然光下，两名成年刀客分立石桥两端静静对峙，目光相对，各自仅微调右手握柄，全程固定全景，不交手，无台词。'
$answerPath = Join-Path $root 'answer.md'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($answerPath, $answer, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
if ($answer.Length -gt 100) { throw 'Answer exceeds 100 characters.' }
if (($answer.ToCharArray() | Where-Object { $_ -in @('。','！','？') }).Count -ne 1) { throw 'Answer must have exactly one sentence.' }
$script:records.outputs = @([ordered]@{ path = $answerPath; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $answerPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); character_count = $answer.Length })
'answer.md saved; ' + $answer.Length + ' characters; one Chinese sentence.'
Get-Content -LiteralPath $answerPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
